excerpt: Inspect an Ajman apartment before buying: check the unit, common areas, documents, costs and repairs with a structured checklist.
introduction:
An apartment inspection is a chance to check whether the property you plan to buy matches the plan, photographs and your expectations. In Ajman, inspect the actual unit and its building, then verify the ownership, clearance and cost documents separately. A tidy viewing is useful but does not replace a qualified technical inspection or legal checks.

Take notes, photographs with permission and a copy of the floor plan. Ask for professional help where you cannot safely test equipment or assess a suspected defect.
takeaways: Inspect the actual unit, common areas, allocated parking and access at a convenient time.
Check cooling, water, windows and visible moisture, and obtain professional advice for significant defects.
Verify title, buyer eligibility, service charges, clearance and any mortgage or tenancy before committing.

sections.heading: Before the viewing
sections.body:
Confirm the unit number, floor, building, advertised area, asking price and whether the apartment is vacant or tenanted. Request the floor plan and a list of included parking, appliances or furniture. If the listing uses a project-wide image, ask to see the exact apartment.

Prepare questions about service charges, utility and cooling arrangements, maintenance history, building rules and any work agreed before transfer. For a family home, bring the measurements of essential furniture and check whether the layout suits the household.

Use the [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) to assess location, but verify the actual entrance, surrounding street and routes at useful times.

table.caption: Apartment inspection checklist
rows: Record defects and request repair estimates
Cooling, taps, hot water and electrical fittings
Ask for maintenance records and qualified tests
Lifts, common areas, access and parking
Title, plan, clearance, loan and tenancy
Verify with the relevant authority and parties

sections.heading: Inspect the apartment room by room
sections.body:
Walk the complete unit, including bathrooms, kitchen, storage and balcony where present. Open doors and windows, check locks and look for visible stains, cracks or signs of water damage. Note odours or unusual noise and ask what repairs have been carried out. A visible mark may have several causes; do not diagnose it without an appropriate professional.

Check taps, drainage and hot water where it is safe and permitted. Ask how cooling is supplied, whether equipment is operational and who maintains it. Record the condition of included appliances and fixtures. A brief test at a viewing does not guarantee long-term performance.

Compare the plan with the rooms and any alterations. Ask whether modifications were approved and whether the stated area and parking are supported by the relevant records.

sections.heading: Inspect the building and surroundings
sections.body:
Look at the entrance, corridors, lift, stairs, lighting, access control and common areas. Confirm the location and dimensions of the allocated parking space and the route to the apartment. If a pool, gym or play area matters to you, check that it serves the building and is operating rather than assuming that a marketing image describes the current facilities.

Ask management about ongoing work, fault reporting, service-charge statements and any known major repairs. The [Ajman service-charge guide](/journal/apartment-service-charges-in-ajman-explained) explains why the annual budget matters to an owner.

Visit the street at another time to observe access, traffic and noise. For a rental investment, consider whether the building's condition and practical facilities suit your intended tenant, but do not assume a specific rent.

sections.heading: Verify the legal and financial documents
sections.body:
Check the title or applicable initial registration, the seller's identity and authority, the buyer's eligibility for the exact property and any existing mortgage or lease. Request current service-charge and arrears information, developer clearance and an itemised transaction quote.

The [Ajman sale registration service](https://www.ajman.ae/en/servicecatalog/services/3162) describes the process and lists developer clearance for real estate units. Ask the department to clarify the fee and documents for your case; do not treat an inspection as proof of ownership.

If there is a mortgage, obtain the lender's settlement and release instructions. Where the unit is tenanted, review the lease, deposit and rights associated with the transfer. Seek qualified advice where the documents or obligations are unclear.

sections.heading: Turn findings into a decision
sections.body:
Group findings into items that need urgent professional investigation, repairs you can price, and matters that need documents or confirmation. Obtain written quotes and agree in writing which work the seller will complete or whether the buyer will take responsibility. Do not assume a seller's promise is included unless it is recorded in the agreement.

The chart is an example of how one buyer might divide attention across inspection tasks. It uses sample planning weights, not measured defect rates or a rating of Ajman buildings. Adjust the checklist to the property and your intended use.

chart.title: Example inspection priorities
chart.note: Example weights total 100 points and help organise the inspection priorities.

sections.heading: When should you arrange a specialist?
sections.body:
Consider an independent qualified inspection when the apartment is older, has significant alterations, shows signs of moisture or contains equipment you cannot assess. Ask the inspector what the report covers, what cannot be tested without opening walls or isolating systems, and whether they can provide an itemised list of defects.

If a structural, electrical or water issue is suspected, seek the appropriate specialist rather than relying on a general viewing. Obtain estimates from suitable contractors and check whether building approvals are needed before work begins. Read the sale agreement to understand the time allowed for inspection and what happens if a significant problem is found. Keep the report and seller's written response with your records.

sections.heading: Review your shortlist
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas Ajman project collection](/projects?emirate=Ajman) for relevant residential projects and request the exact unit details and current availability. Keep a separate inspection record for each apartment so differences are easy to compare.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with your preferred location, budget and intended use. Verify documents, obtain any necessary technical inspection and agree the treatment of defects before committing.
